doc: PROFILE.md 7.2: '**`filters.decimation` accepts a non-integer `step`.** A `step` below 1.0 is still refused (`Option step must be >= 1.0`), but any value at or above it is honoured as written rather than truncated to an integer.'  stages/filters.decimation.rst, Options: step 'Number of points to skip between each sample point. [...] A step of 1.6 will retain ``100 / 1.6 = 62.5%`` of the points. [Default: 1.0]' -- the page shows a fractional step being honoured but states no lower bound, so the bound and its message come from the profile.  0.5 is below it, so the pipeline must be refused and no output written.  The wording is graded here only because 7.2 quotes it verbatim as part of the requirement.  The regex is unanchored and escapes the `.` of `1.0`: `driver.py` passes no flags to `re.search`, so `^` would anchor at the start of the whole captured stream, and the quoted text appears after the stage prefix the application adds.
